tools.name: list_pathways
tools.description:
List the citizenship-by-descent pathways this server can evaluate.

    Returns each supported pathway with its summary, official sources and
    verification date. Countries marked 'planned' have no rules implemented
    yet and are listed so their status is clear.

tools.name: check_descent_eligibility
tools.description:

tools.name: get_pathway_requirements
tools.description:
Documents, cost, and processing time for a supported descent pathway.

    Covers the documents to gather, fees, typical processing time and common
    pitfalls, with official sources.

tools.name: get_visa_options
tools.description:

tools.name: get_move_checklist
tools.description:
Step-by-step application checklist for one visa, with sources.

    Takes a visa_id such as 'es_dnv' or 'pt_d7'. Also returns the fees and any
    recent rule changes for that visa.

tools.name: get_rule_changes
tools.description:
Recent changes to visa and residence rules that GoThere has verified.

    Newest first. Each entry has the old and new value and the official source.

    Args:
        country: Optional ISO alpha-2 code or English name.
        since: Optional date; only changes on or after it are returned.
